newsitem.title: USA: Park Natl, First-Knox to merge.
newsitem.headline: Park Natl, First-Knox to merge.

text.p: Park National Corp and First-Knox Banc Corp Tuesday that they have signed a definitive agreement to merge in a transaction that valued at $114.3 million, based on Friday's closing prices.
Under the terms of the agreement, First-Knox stockholders will receive 0.5914 shares of Park common stock for each share of First-Knox common stock, in a tax-free exchange.
Park said it expects to issue 2,345,000 shares of stock to complete the merger, which will be accounted for as a pooling-of-interests.
The transaction is now valued at about $29 per Fist-Knox share and is 2.38 times First-Knox' September 30 book value and 17.4 times the trailing 12 months First-Knox per share earnings, it said.
Park said it anticipated the merger to result in annual pre-tax non-interest expense savings of about $900,000 in 1997, with additional savings of $1 million expected in 1998.
It added that with these savings and a lesser amount of revenue enhancements, the deal will be accretive to Park's earnings per share in 1998, the first full year of combined operations.
It said it expects this transaction "to significantly enhance the combined company's future earnings."
